instruction.text: Jerome is supposed to learn three new ways to stay safe while swimming. Look at his flashcards.

atoms.b: I don’t go swimming if I feel unwell.
I don’t go into the water when I’m hungry or straight after eating.
I cool down before I go into the water.

atoms.text: Jerome has memorised the ways he can stay safe, but he still has some questions about why they are important. That’s why he talks to his aunt, who works as a doctor.

atoms.b: I don’t understand. Why should I only go swimming when I feel well? What’s wrong with going swimming when you have a cold?

When you have a cold, you often feel much ((++weaker fitter)). Swimming is hard work, which can lead to the cold getting ((++worse better)). It is also ((++dangerous easy)) to swim when your body has less strength than usual.

atoms.b: Okay, so I’d better rest when I’m sick.
But why do I need to cool down before swimming? I’d rather just jump straight into the water!

I understand that. However, the temperature difference between cold water and your warm body is very ((++big small)). Jumping into the water can cause your ((++muscles teeth)) to cramp so much that you can no longer swim.
atoms.sound: I understand that. However, the temperature difference between cold water and your warm body is very big. Jumping into the water can cause your muscles to cramp so much that you can no longer swim.

atoms.b: In addition, if you ((++suddenly slowly)) immerse yourself in cold water, you can struggle to breathe. This is very dangerous. That’s why you should begin by ((++slowly quickly)) entering the water or taking a cool shower.

atoms.b: That makes sense. I can still jump into the water once I’m wet and I am used to the temperature!
Why shouldn’t I swim when I’m hungry or directly after eating?
Your body needs energy to ((++digest eat)) after eating a big meal. Swimming is very strenuous, so right after eating you might not have enough ((++energy skill)) to swim properly.

Swimming on an empty stomach is also bad because you will not have enough energy to swim. It is best to eat something ((++light heavy)) that contains a lot of water. Fruit, a salad or even an ice cream are easier to ((++digest throw)) than pizza or chips, for example.
